fade_audit.break_even_basis: mean inverse opposite decimal price among non-push fade quotes; book-implied and includes market margin
fade_audit.confidence_probability_basis: numeric calibrated_probability, falling back to raw_probability; calibration status is not used
fade_audit.evidence_policy: use only explicit opposite-side prices preserved in the pick's same BookSnapshot; never infer or historically backfill quotes
fade_audit.profit_basis: fade win earns opposite decimal price minus one; fade loss loses one; push returns stake; ROI divides by one unit per priced fade, including pushes
